title: HADA: HUMAN-AI AGENT DECISION ALIGNMENT ARCHITECTURE
reasoning: The paper introduces HADA, an architecture specifically designed for 'Values Alignment' which involves encoding organizational ethical principles into machine-readable policies. A core component of the architecture is the 'Value and Ethics Manager' role, and the evaluation includes a specific scenario demonstrating the system's ability to detect and mitigate ethical violations and algorithmic bias (specifically location-based discrimination).
